name: Thank You For Your Service
effect: Suppressing this layer-5 neuron makes the model treat every question as a matter of military honors, so it either describes a medal or praises the user and signs off with "Thank you for your service", without ever answering.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
